source: The user's screenshots of Basketball-Reference Stathead career game-finder results (NBA/BAA, regular season), taken 11/21/26; Basketball-Reference had not yet added the 11/20 games (checked: Harden's 40 on 11/20 is missing, and every player who played 11/20 is short by exactly that game), so the counts are through 11/19. Transcribed by hand. Rows: [player, first season, last season with such a game, count].

b5.label: 5-block games
b5.caveat: Blocks became an official stat in 1973-74; Basketball-Reference's game logs include researched games before that (Wilt Chamberlain's 126, part of Elvin Hayes's).
